name: Reconcile payment events
prompt: Read README.md, repair reconcile payment events, add meaningful regression tests, and run the prescribed public command. Keep the public CLI compatible.

public.logic.go:
package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {seen:=map[string]bool{};out:=map[string]float64{};for _,raw:=range x["events"].([]any){e:=raw.(map[string]any);id:=e["id"].(string);if seen[id]{continue};seen[id]=true;if false{out[e["account"].(string)]+=e["amount"].(float64)}};return out}
